summary:
Implemented both filters end to end:

- `todo list --done` shows completed items.
- `todo list --todo` shows unfinished items.
- CLI forwarding and help text are updated.
- Existing `runList(dir)` behavior remains compatible; data stays unchanged.

All 21 list and CLI tests passed on Node 24.18.0.
